headline: Check Tide Boards Before Coastal Promontory Walks
reservation: Entry to the Gower National Landscape is generally open with no central gate system. However, specific areas managed by the National Trust may require parking fees or have localized access constraints; always verify current site-specific rules with official Welsh agency notices.

days.title: Iconic Bays and Tidal Adventures

stops.name: Three Cliffs Bay
stops.detail: View the jagged limestone peaks and the ruins of Pennard Castle where the Pennard Pill river meets the sea.

stops.name: Rhosili
stops.detail: Walk the three-mile stretch of golden sands to see the shipwreck and watch paragliders on the downs.

stops.name: Worm's Head
stops.detail: Cross the causeway to this rocky promontory, ensuring you return within the four-hour low tide window.

days.driving: Allow 60-90 minutes for total transit between bays; roads are often narrow and winding.
days.note: Worm's Head is strictly tide-dependent; check the official board near the causeway before crossing.

intel.title: Tidal Windows
intel.text: The causeway to Worm's Head is only reachable for two hours either side of low tide. Always consult the local tide board to avoid being marooned.

intel.title: Three Cliffs Approach
intel.text: Reaching Three Cliffs Bay requires a significant walk through the wooded hillside. This distance typically results in a quieter experience than other beaches.

intel.title: National Trust Sites
intel.text: Major sites like Rhossili have designated parking, though availability varies by season. Consult National Trust Wales for specific site capacities.

intel.title: Rural Connectivity
intel.text: Mobile signal strength is not documented in available evidence for the peninsula interior. Verify local coverage or carry physical maps for the Gower Way.

intel.title: Local Services
intel.text: Specific fuel station locations are not provided in official excerpts. Ensure your vehicle is sufficiently fueled in Swansea before entering the peninsula.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental in Swansea and head west; this gateway city provides the primary access to the south and north Gower coasts.
plan.vehicle: Suitable for standard cars; check for restrictions if using large RVs on narrow coastal lanes.
plan.goldenHour: Rhossili Downs offers a high vantage point for sunset views over Rhossili Bay and Worm's Head.
